Good morning everyone. As you all know, forklift battery B-14 overheated while charging at Dock 2 — we had smoke but no visible flame. Dock 2 is going to stay closed until I can authorize a controlled reopening with the proper safety controls in place. In the meantime, the warehouse needs to keep processing outbound orders from the other docks.

Per our incident-response routine, I need each area — maintenance, warehouse logistics, fire protection, and training and staffing — to report your current findings to me before I can authorize reopening. Once everyone has reported, I can settle the reopening plan immediately; we don't need to wait for action completions or later documentation before I record the plan.

So let's get started. Could maintenance please report first on what you've found regarding the battery and charging station at Dock 2?
